# Analyze Nabla performance

Use `review-performance-evidence`, then the existing kernel or model
microbenchmark skill when measurements are requested. Read the current
benchmark documents and raw data. Distinguish kernel timing, forward latency
and serving throughput; include variability, latency and regressions.
Local analysis of public artifacts is permitted. Provisioning GPU resources,
accessing private checkpoints or running paid experiments needs task-specific
authorization and the relevant execution environment; do not infer it from this profile.
